newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE SAYS SEEKS TO LIST KOMATSU ELECTRONIC METALS.
newsitem.headline: TSE SAYS SEEKS TO LIST KOMATSU ELECTRONIC METALS.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Thursday that it had applied to the Finance Ministry for permission to list Komatsu Electronic Metals Co Ltd.
Komatsu Electronic is likely to be listed on the second section of the TSE on September 12, the TSE said in a statement.
The company plans to issue five million new shares and to offer 1.3 million shares through a secondary offering, the TSE said.
Komatsu Electronic, which is 62.84 percent owned by machinery maker Komatsu Ltd, makes and sells silicon wafers.
